description: feat(worker): the Base pipeline step - activity rwc-base-local after PlaneCut in EditPlatformJobLocal, a round manifold-3d base with embossed / debossed text merged under the model, baseGeneration + platformProcessing logs
specRef: rwclab-structure.md «Board 9»; README.md «Pipeline (local)» step 4, «How the flow maps to the original RayWare Cloud»
notes:
WHY: the base is a pipeline algorithm like plane cut (Step Functions -> Activity -> this worker), not a browser-side trick: the user asked for the SprintRay shape (lambdas / step functions + a job log when done). The emulator cannot run manifold-3d as a Lambda (its Lambda runtime has no WebAssembly - probed 27.11.2026), so the step is a Lambda-shaped module (baseStep(input, ws) -> output) behind an Activity, exactly like import and plane-cut.
PROBED 27.11.2026 against the running emulator (keep it this way): a state machine { PlaneCut: Task(activity A, ResultPath: null, Next: "Base"), Base: Task(activity B, End) } runs both top-level Activities in order and the Base task receives the ORIGINAL execution input unchanged (ResultPath null discards the PlaneCut output), execution SUCCEEDED. Map/Parallel are still not allowed around Activities (aws-emulator/README.md).
INFRA (infra/resources.mjs): R.activities.base = "rwc-base-local"; definitions.editPlatformJob becomes StartAt PlaneCut, States: PlaneCut { Type Task, Resource arn.activity(R.activities.planeCut), TimeoutSeconds 300, ResultPath: null, Next: "Base" }, Base { Type Task, Resource arn.activity(R.activities.base), TimeoutSeconds 600, End: true }; update the Comment ("Renderer Confirm -> per-model edit operations: plane cut / transform, then the base. Original RWC: plane-cut / line-cut / ... -> generate-support -> merge-job"). infra/bootstrap.mjs needs no code change (activities() and stateMachines() loop over R; UpdateStateMachine picks up the new definition) - only its header comment ("import / plane-cut / base activities"). Do NOT run the bootstrap or docker compose yourself: 9310 brings the stack up with the new definition.
WORKER WIRING: workers/algorithms/src/worker.mjs HANDLERS gets `[process.env.RWC_ACTIVITY_BASE || "rwc-base-local"]: { algorithm: "baseGeneration", fn: baseStep }` (import from ./steps/base.mjs). On a thrown error worker.mjs already publishes `<algorithm> <status>` + SendTaskFailure; the base step itself publishes platformProcessing 500 in its catch like plane-cut.mjs does.
DEPENDENCIES (workers/algorithms/package.json, you are the only task touching it): three "0.131.3" -> "0.186.1" (the worker uses Matrix4 / Quaternion only; FontLoader comes from three/examples/jsm/loaders/FontLoader.js) and add "manifold-3d": "^3.5.5". Regenerate package-lock.json with npm (node 24 on the host is fine for the lock; the image is node:24-bookworm-slim deps + amazonlinux runtime, WASM works there). Copy the font: NEW FILE workers/algorithms/fonts/helvetiker_regular.typeface.json = app/frontend/src/assets/fonts/helvetiker_regular.typeface.json (byte copy; the Dockerfile COPYs src only - add `COPY fonts ./fonts` to workers/algorithms/Dockerfile... NOTE the Dockerfile is NOT in your files list: put the font under workers/algorithms/src/fonts/helvetiker_regular.typeface.json instead, which the existing `COPY src ./src` ships, and read it relative to import.meta.url).
ALGORITHM (workers/algorithms/src/steps/base.mjs, port the probe): input = the edit message { platformId, models: [{ individualId, position, rotation, scale, base, ... }] } (base = the contract object or null/undefined). plan = planBase(input.models) (base-logic.mjs). For EACH model, meta = GetItem RWC_INDIVIDUAL_METADATA_LOCAL (ConsistentRead), existing = meta.STL.Base ? JSON.parse(meta.STL.Base) : null (STL.Base is a JSON STRING: every STL attribute the backend reads is a string). Cases: (a) base null and no existing -> noop. (b) base null and existing -> REMOVE: download delta/individual/{id}/original/{id}.drc, upload it as shared/{id}.drc, DynamoDB UpdateItem REMOVE STL.Base + set STL.Position y = -(bounds of that drc).min[1] * scale.y and LastModified; delete original/{id}.drc (add `remove(key)` = DeleteObjectCommand to aws.mjs). (c) base given -> BUILD: source = existing ? original/{id}.drc : shared/{id}.drc; if !existing, copy shared -> original first (the un-based mesh is kept once so a later text change rebuilds from it; a plane cut after a base drops it, see below). Decode the source with draco3d in JS (add `drcMesh(file)` to mesh.mjs next to drcBounds: positions Float32Array + indices Uint32Array via decoder.GetTrianglesUInt32Array). Apply the model ROTATION to the positions (three Quaternion from the RWC w,x,y,z string, like initMatrix in plane-cut.mjs, no translation, no scale) so the footprint is measured in the pose the user sees; bounds b in LOCAL units. The renderer applies STL.Scale to the whole .drc, so every mm value is converted to local units by the scale component: sc = scale string or "1,1,1"; x/z lengths / sc[0], heights / sc[1]. Footprint widthMm = (b.max.x - b.min.x) * sc[0], depthMm = (b.max.z - b.min.z) * sc[2]; diameterMm = base.diameterMm ?? autoDiameterMm(widthMm, depthMm); centre cx, cz = footprint centre (local). Disc: top at yTop = b.min.y + BASE_SINK_MM / sc[1], bottom at yTop - base.heightMm / sc[1], radius diameterMm / 2 / sc[0]. Build the base in manifold-3d (Z up, mm): const wasm = await Module(); wasm.setup() ONCE per process (module-level promise); disc = Manifold.cylinder(heightMm, diameterMm / 2, -1, 96, false). Text (only when base.text !== ''): font = new FontLoader().parse(JSON of the typeface file), shapes = font.generateShapes(base.text, base.textSizeMm), for each shape p = shape.extractPoints(4): outer = p.shape as [x, y] pairs - REVERSE it when its signed area is negative (three emits clockwise outers), holes = p.holes - REVERSE each when its area is positive (manifold fills positive outers, negative holes; wrong orientation = EMPTY extrude, probed); text = Manifold.extrude(polys, base.textDepthMm) translated so the glyph bbox is centred in X and its Y bbox spans [-(R - BASE_MARGIN_MM), -(R - BASE_MARGIN_MM - glyphHeight)] (front edge; R = diameterMm / 2), Z = heightMm for emboss (sits on the top face) or heightMm - textDepthMm for deboss; result = emboss ? disc.add(text) : disc.subtract(text); if the glyph bbox does not fit (glyph width > diameter - 2 * margin, or height > R) throw BadRequest 'BASE_TEXT_DOES_NOT_FIT'. mesh = result.getMesh() (numProp 3; triVerts index vertProperties). Map manifold (Z up, Y = front/back) to the model frame (Y up, the default camera sits at +Z: renderer.component.ts camera.position.set(0, 0, 250)): (x, y, z) -> (x, z, -y) is a proper rotation (orientation kept) that puts the manifold -Y text edge at world +Z = towards the camera and the glyph "up" away from the viewer, so the plaque reads correctly from the front; then scale by (1 / sc[0], 1 / sc[1], 1 / sc[2]) and translate to (cx, yTop - heightMm / sc[1], cz) (disc bottom at that Y). Concatenate model triangles + base triangles (one index buffer; no boolean with the model) -> write a BINARY little-endian PLY (add plyWrite(file, positions, indices) to mesh.mjs) -> `center` (MeshTransformer -c, as import does) -> dracoEncode -> b2 = drcBounds -> upload shared/{id}.drc and based/{id}.drc; UpdateItem: STL.Position = "x,-b2.min[1]*sc[1],z" (keep x/z of the stored Position), STL.Rotation = "1,0,0,0" (the rotation is baked, like plane cut), STL.Base = JSON.stringify(normalized base), LastModified. Return per model { individualId, action: 'base' | 'removeBase' | 'noop', diameterMm?, bounds? }.
LOGS: after all models: if any action was base/removeBase -> publishAlgorithmDone({ algorithm: "baseGeneration", platformId, status: 200, individualIds: [those] }); then ALWAYS publishAlgorithmDone({ algorithm: "platformProcessing", platformId, status: 200, individualIds: all }) - this is the final log of the whole edit chain now (the renderer loader waits for it). Failure: catch -> platformProcessing 500 with errorCode (like plane-cut.mjs) and rethrow (worker.mjs publishes baseGeneration <status> + SendTaskFailure). BadRequest codes: BASE_TEXT_DOES_NOT_FIT, and whatever normalizeBase throws.
PLANE-CUT CHANGES (workers/algorithms/src/steps/plane-cut.mjs + workers/algorithms/src/edit-logic.mjs, same lane): finalLogs(plan) returns ["planeCut"] when something was cut, else [] - the PlaneCut state no longer publishes platformProcessing (the Base state does, once, at the end of the chain); update edit-logic tests accordingly (platform-process.test.mjs / a new edit-logic test if finalLogs is tested there). cutOne: when meta.STL.Base exists, after the cut REMOVE STL.Base and delete original/{id}.drc (the cut mesh is the new un-based mesh; the Base state in the same execution rebuilds the base from it when the message carries `base`, so the user sees cut + base after one Confirm). planEdit: pass `base` through untouched (not in UNSUPPORTED). Header comments of plane-cut.mjs / edit-logic.mjs updated.
TESTS: workers/algorithms/test/base-logic.test.mjs exists (9005) - extend if planBase changes. NEW FILE workers/algorithms/test/base-geometry.test.mjs (node:test; this one IMPORTS manifold-3d, three and the step's pure geometry helpers - put the geometry (buildBase({ diameterMm, heightMm, text, textStyle, textSizeMm, textDepthMm }, fontJson) -> { positions, indices, volume, genus } and the frame mapping / concat helpers) in NEW FILE workers/algorithms/src/base-geometry.mjs so the test does not need AWS): emboss volume > plain disc volume > deboss volume for "ORC"; genus 0 for all three; a clockwise polygon input to the orientation helper is reversed; the mapped base lies below y = yTop and inside the radius around (cx, cz); concat keeps model indices and offsets base indices; BASE_TEXT_DOES_NOT_FIT for a 16-char text at textSizeMm 12 on a 20 mm disc. The host has node 24; the verify installs the worker deps on the host (node_modules is gitignored) before node --test.
